Kettlecorn
 
Save Print
Author: Amy Simonsen
Recipe type: Dessert
Cuisine: American
Ingredients
  • ¼ Cup(s) canola oil
  • ½ Cup(s) powdered sugar
  • ½ Cup(s) yellow popcorn
  • 2 Tablespoon(s) granulated sugar
  • 1 Teaspoon(s) kosher salt
Instructions
  1. In 5 Quart pan add oil and powder sugar, then heat oil over high heat. Mix as the oil heats, it will be very pasty, but as the oil heats the paste will turn to liquid. When it is hot enough, the sugar begins to create brown liquid pockets.
  2. Put in the popcorn, cover. Occasionally pick up the pan and vigorously shake (probably not needed, but fun, and it makes this look more impressive). Popping time is about 2-3 minutes.
  3. When the popcorn starts to push the lid up, or popping stops, take off the stove and dump into large bowl.

  5. using a large fork/spoon to stir the popcorn, sprinkle the sugar over the popcorn. Then sprinkle the salt. Taste. Add more salt, if needed.
